relationship_to_f0_h0.new_estimand: out-of-player conditional action choice from a fixed low-dimensional visible feature dictionary

formal_question.text: Within the frozen B2 train source domain, can a fixed ten-term, actor-normalized conditional-choice model improve average-unique-player prediction of complete human action choices on unseen source-domain players, and can its predicted positional tier-loss mass discriminate immediate D-to-L choices? Separately, does a one-ply A_pos-preserving predecessor choice have enough positional-only leverage to change that predicted exposure?

two_stage_interpretation.stage_1: predictive association for source-domain human choices and positional tier loss
two_stage_interpretation.stage_2: one-ply positional steerability necessary condition only

train_internal_split.membership_source: F0-D0 manifest plus official B2 train membership only

observation_contract.unit: complete visible predecessor board, legal atomic choice set, observed human action, actor source-player key, game identity
observation_contract.unchosen_actions: choice alternatives, not independent negative examples

feature_dictionary.phase_handling: pooled primary model; placement, movement, and flying reported separately

multiple_recommendation_rule.recommendation_set: all legal actions tied at the maximum feature score
multiple_recommendation_rule.strict_conflict: the entire recommendation set lies outside A_pos
multiple_recommendation_rule.mixed_conflict: the tied maximum set contains both A_pos and non-A_pos actions
multiple_recommendation_rule.direct_joint_rate: observed action is both a feature maximum and outside A_pos

exploration_pilot.purpose: fast rejection-oriented support and conflict-opportunity description
reported_only: possible, strict, and mixed A_pos conflict
phase, color, and positional tier counts
separate W-to-D, W-to-L, and D-to-L counts
Malom query count, time, coverage, and abstention

confirmatory_model.model_family: L2-regularized conditional multinomial logit over each complete legal choice set
confirmatory_model.training_partition: research-exploration excluding the 128-game descriptive pilot only as a sensitivity; primary may include the pilot because features and thresholds were frozen first
confirmatory_model.evaluation_partition: research-confirmation opened once only after a separate execution freeze
confirmatory_model.player_weighting: each actor player has equal total loss weight; decisions within player share that weight
confirmatory_model.feature_standardization: exploration-choice-row mean and standard deviation; zero-variance terms remain present with standardized value zero
confirmatory_model.optimizer_contract: unique convex penalized optimum, gradient infinity norm at most 1e-8
confirmatory_model.malom_role: label A_pos and tier loss after prediction; never a predictor
confirmatory_model.other_transitions: W-to-D and W-to-L always reported separately; zero events remain zero and receive no effect-creating prior

minimum_confirmatory_support.provenance: minimum player-cluster and rare-event support for a ten-term descriptive model; not inherited from F0-H0

feature_identifiability.provenance: requires multiple action-varying and conflict-bearing features before interpreting coefficients

choice_prediction.contrast: geometry control minus full tactical model
choice_prediction.provenance: 0.01 nat is approximately a one-percent per-choice likelihood gain and is the minimum signal that justifies another oracle-backed stage

positional_loss_discrimination.provenance: an independently chosen two-percentage-point discrimination floor; it is not the failed F0-H0 one-percent product bound

oracle_coverage.missing_policy: abstain and count against coverage; never impute

one_ply_steerability_necessary_condition.execution_order: only after every predictive confirmation gate passes
one_ply_steerability_necessary_condition.definition: at an observed predecessor decision, enumerate all actor A_pos actions and compute the frozen human model's next-player positional unsafe mass at each settled successor
one_ply_steerability_necessary_condition.support_abstention: abstain when successor phase is absent from exploration or any standardized action feature has absolute value above four
one_ply_steerability_necessary_condition.interpretation: positional one-ply structural leverage necessary condition; not causal inducement, reachability under repeated play, A_allow, or product conversion

decision_rule.feature_direction_rejected: any confirmatory support, identifiability, choice-prediction, positional-loss, stability, oracle-coverage, or one-ply necessary-condition gate fails
decision_rule.feature_signal_screen_passed_no_later_au: all gates pass; permits only a later design decision and no E0, training, reward, game, promotion, or product claim
decision_rule.inconclusive: required content or oracle coverage is unavailable, or a prespecified interval cannot be computed

sparsity_curve_disposition.f0_h0_state_coverage_extrapolation: rejected because it would reopen the immutable failed estimator
sparsity_curve_disposition.allowed_future_redefinition: player-cluster learning curve for the fixed feature model only
sparsity_curve_disposition.far_extrapolation_prohibited: no projection beyond twice observed player support
sparsity_curve_disposition.model_form_guard: at least power-law, Michaelis-Menten, and log forms must backtest; disagreement above twofold is reported as unidentified

known_biases.history_recovery_selection: excluded 1751 games contain only 35 draws; retained 92789 contain 26157 draws
known_biases.product_user_target_distribution: absent; no product-population reweighting is identifiable
known_biases.state_novelty: not attainable and not used as a gate
